description: Says whether Mercury, Venus, Mars, Jupiter, Saturn, Uranus, Neptune or Pluto is retrograde on a date and which phase it is in, with the sign, pre-shadow, station retrograde, cazimi (Mercury, Venus) or opposition (Mars through Pluto), station direct, post-shadow end and days left to the next transition. Times are UTC, to the minute, from the ephemeris (JPL DE421, 2025–2030). This is astronomical timing, not a horoscope.

date.description: Date to check as YYYY-MM-DD (read as 12:00 UTC). Defaults to now.

name: is_planet_retrograde
title: Is a planet retrograde?
